name: Email sign-in is required before opening Cue Check
description: Verifies signed-out visitors see the email sign-in screen and cannot access the service workspace until authenticated.
steps: Open Cue Check in a signed-out browser session
Verify the email sign-in screen is shown
expected: The service workspace is only shown after successful email authentication.

name: Download a complete service activity PDF
covers: completed and pending activities in PDF
checker name and email in PDF
description: Verifies the PDF file contains the service details, checker identity, every checklist activity and its completion state.
steps: Start a service check and enter a checker name
Mark one activity complete and leave another pending
expected: A PDF downloads with service name, date, start time, checker name, account email, completion percentage, status, all activities and notes.

name: Switch between day and night appearance
description: Verifies the theme toggle changes the workspace appearance and remembers the selected mode after reload.
steps: Sign in and open the workspace
expected: The light and dark appearances both render correctly and the selected appearance is retained after refresh.

name: Create and retain a named service check
description: Verifies a signed-in checker can create a service check, mark activities and find the record in history after reload.
steps: Start a service check with a checker name
Open History and refresh the page
expected: The saved service appears in history with its checker, date and completion count.

name: Validate checker name and keep mobile workflow usable
description: Verifies a service check cannot be started without a checker name and the main workflow remains usable on mobile.
steps: Leave Name of checker empty and submit
Enter a checker name and begin the check
expected: The required checker name is enforced and the checklist and Download PDF action fit the mobile layout.
